about_the_game:
overthrown interactive presents our debut demo —

Welcome to Red Light White Light, a terrifying new horror experience where survival depends on your ability to move at the right time — and stay perfectly still when death is watching.

In this single-player horror, move when the light’s white — freeze when it’s red — or face what waits in the dark. Hold your focus where it matters — on survival.

Will you keep your nerve, or will fear claim your final breath?

Can you survive Red Light White Light?
The demo drops soon with updates to come. Wishlist now.

This demo version of Red Light White Light includes:

  • 1 playable survival map

  • Full monster encounter and death sequence

  • Randomized light pattern system

  • Core gameplay loop and horror audio

  • Victory and Game Over screens

Note:
This is an early demo build and represents a vertical slice of core gameplay. Future updates and the full release will include:

  • Multiple maps and difficulty levels

  • Multiplayer mode

  • Additional monster variants and death animations

  • Expanded audio and environmental effects

Join our discord for comments/suggestions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 1903
  • Processor: intel i3-10100 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: VRAM r7 370 (or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 2 Gb of VRAM is needed
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 22H2
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 2600 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 (or equivalent)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 4 Gb of VRAM is needed

short_description: Red Light White Light is a first-person, single-player horror reimagining of the classic childhood game where one wrong move seals your fate. Stay in the Light… or Die in the Dark.
